subject: Re: Redwood pricing discussion — token volumes & stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Ben Harris <ben.harris@finex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood pricing discussion — tokens and budget

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call today — good overview from both sides. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align internally: 

- Expected monthly token volume: ~50M tokens/month initially (we expect to ramp to ~150M tokens/month by Q4 if pilot looks good)
- Primary workload: customer support summarization + ML-assisted search (mix of short and long context)

Questions for you:
1) What is Redwood's target $ / 1M tokens we should plan for at the 50M and 150M volume levels with a 12-month commitment?
2) Can you confirm who at Finex will be the contract signer / economic buyer vs. the day-to-day budget owner? I can loop them in once we have ballpark pricing.
3) Could you send an indicative pricing sheet or model we can run against our projected volumes?

If you can share an initial price range and a simple model (tokens -> monthly cost -> $/1M tokens), that will help us get finance and procurement eyes on this.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Harris
Director of AI Products | Finex
ben.harris@finex.com | (415) 555-0148

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Harris <ben.harris@finex.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing discussion — tokens and budget

Hi Ben — great talking yesterday, appreciate the clear volume context. Per your request, attaching an initial pricing model (lightweight) and a short note on unit economics below. Attaching: Finex_Redwood_pricing_model_v1.xlsx

Quick summary (indicative, subject to final contract/commitments):
- List pricing (no commitment): $1,800 / 1M tokens
- 12‑month, 50M/mo commit (tiered): approx $1,100 — $1,300 / 1M tokens depending on exact seq length mix and latency SLOs
- 12‑month, 150M/mo commit (tiered): approx $850 — $1,000 / 1M tokens
- Typical enterprise discount levers: committed volume, term length, dedicated capacity requirement, and SLO (latency/throughput).

Unit economics notes (for your finance):
- We model cost per 1M tokens in two pieces: serving (GPU + infra amortization) + model + ops (observability/backups).
- Example blended unit econ for 150M commit: gross cost ~$400/1M tokens -> indicative customer price $850/1M -> ~50% gross margin. We can share more detailed model if helpful.

Next steps / asks for your side:
1) Confirm economic buyer (who signs contracts) and the budget owner (who approves monthly spend). If different, please share names & emails.
2) Does Finex need a PO + vendor onboarding checklist? If yes, please loop procurement (or share the contact).
3) Are there any security/compliance artifacts you need upfront (SOC2, data routing details)? Soojin — FYI in case we need to prep those.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- We will send a one‑page mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones (pilot, evaluation, contract) and a simple pricing appendix by EOD Friday.
- If you can confirm the economic buyer + budget owner this week, we can scope a short pilot pricing and the contract path.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199

--
Attachment: Finex_Redwood_pricing_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with tiered pricing, sample run-rate calculations)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood pricing discussion — tokens and budget

Hi Ben — quick note from the engineering side to clarify a couple of items Marissa mentioned that will affect pricing ranges:

- Sequence length mix: if your median context is >1k tokens we should account for higher per-token cost due to KV cache size; that tends to push the effective $/1M toward the upper range. If you have a sample distribution we can run a quick estimate.
- Burst requirements: if you need guaranteed sub‑1200ms p95 we may need dedicated capacity, which changes the pricing floor (we'll show that in the MAP).
- Pilot scope: for an initial pilot (up to 50M tokens / month, no dedicated) we can keep you in the mid-range ($1,100‑$1,300 / 1M) and then reprice on committed higher throughput.

Happy to jump on a short call with your infra/ML ops folks if that helps.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
